summary: Phase 82 · RBAC Menu Access Control end-to-end backend + frontend testing PASSED. Backend pytest 19/19 (1 skipped due to unrelated stale seed) covers /api/rbac/menus (59), /api/rbac/roles (>=8 system), /api/auth/me/permissions (admin=all-true), admin permissions cannot be restricted (PUT admin → 400), custom role creation defaults ALL-OFF, custom role delete, save with change count + audit old→new entry, reset restores full access, non-admin (hr) → 403 on /api/rbac/*, hr can still read own /api/auth/me/permissions. Frontend E2E on /menu-access-control verified: role selector renders all 8 system roles, selecting Accountant shows menu tree with 7 action checkboxes per row (data-testid mac-chk-<menuId>-<action>), Save disabled until dirty, save→confirm dialog (mac-confirm-dialog)→mac-confirm-save persists, Audit Log tab shows the change, Admin role shows mac-admin-note + all checkboxes disabled, custom role creation (mac-new-role-input + mac-create-role) appears in selector with all checkboxes unchecked, mac-delete-role removes it. Enforcement flow verified end-to-end: created accountant test user, restricted subscription.view=OFF, logged in as that user → (a) Subscription group HIDDEN from sidebar (Dashboard/OrgMgmt/Batch/Finance/Approvals/Candidate/HR/Procurement/Partnerships still visible), (b) GET /api/subscription/status returns 403 (middleware Phase-1 VIEW enforcement working), (c) /api/auth/me/permissions returns is_admin=false subscription.view=false, (d) direct nav to /menu-access-control redirects to / (ProtectedRoute requireAdmin gate working). Reset restored access.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed — user cleanup after admin-driven creation is not supported via this route. Pre-existing (not Phase 82). Test users created for RBAC verification cannot be cleanly removed by the same admin flow that created them.

critical_code_review_comments: Middleware rbac_view_enforcement correctly exempts /api/auth and /api/rbac so admins can never lock themselves out of the RBAC console — good.
_role_perm_map treats admin/super_admin as all-true unconditionally (short-circuit before DB read) — cannot be restricted even if DB rows exist. Correct.
System roles with no stored rows default to full access (_default_perm(is_system=True)) — matches 'no-lockout' requirement.
Custom (non-system) roles default all-off (_default_perm(is_system=False)) — matches requirement.
PUT /api/rbac/permissions/admin correctly returns 400 (admin cannot be restricted). Verified.
Audit log captures actor_id, actor_name, role_key, and per-action old→new booleans — sufficient for compliance trail.
_menu_for_path uses longest-prefix match (best is None or len(pfx) > best[1]) — correct for overlapping prefixes.

Phase-1 VIEW enforcement only wires 6 prefix groups (subscription/centers/users/rbac/batch bundle/dashboard.settlement) — Phase-2 granular create/edit/delete enforcement is TODO but UI already saves those checkboxes for future use (documented in review request).

Center-data isolation and menu-permission are two independent controls in code — menu.view=ON does NOT widen the center filter (dashboards still apply _wo_center_filter/assigned_center_ids). Verified.
PermissionContext reloads via /api/auth/me/permissions after any Save/Reset, so sidebar updates without full reload.
server.py file size (23,229 lines) still exceeds 700-line guideline — long-standing, out of scope.
